_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google.' 'We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising.' 'We face intense competition.' 'Our operating results have fluctuated, and may in the future fluctuate, as a result of a number of factors, many outside of our control, including the cyclical nature and seasonality in our business and geopolitical events.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions.' (FY2023 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclical nature and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) is scoped to public cloud displacing on-premise IT, and this 10-K names the cloud as Google's own business ('Within Google Cloud, we devote significant resources to develop and deploy our enterprise-ready cloud services, including Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace') and enterprise cloud providers as its competitors, so it is out of scope (the AVGO FY2012 and NVDA reading); ECOMMERCE (from 2015-01-01), STREAMING (from 2015-08-04) and ENERGY_TRANSITION (from 2015-12-12) are scoped to physical retail, linear TV and pay-TV bundles, and fossil fuels; EV (from 2020-01-01) to combustion-engine vehicles and their suppliers; CRYPTO (from 2020-10-21) to payment networks, banks and exchanges; GLP1 (from 2023-08-08) to snacks, beverages and medical devices; GENAI (live from 2022-11-30; scoped to generative AI substituting core products, search among them) is on the watch list from this 10-K, whose competition risk factor names AI technology and services as highly competitive and other companies' AI products as possibly similar or superior to Google's (its GENAI event): company-acknowledged, with no market read, as no dated evidence in the registry or the fact sheet shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Google Search (no press coverage is added after 2023, the ACN rule); the competition named is a competitive field and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

theme_watch.reason: Live: Alphabet's own FY2023 10-K, under 'We face intense competition.', says 'AI technology and services are highly competitive, rapidly evolving, and require significant investment, including development and operational costs, to meet the changing needs and expectations of our existing users and attract new users.' and 'Additionally, other companies may develop AI products and technologies that are similar or superior to our technologies or more cost-effective to deploy.' It builds generative AI of its own: 'We are expanding our investment in AI across the entire company. This includes generative AI and continuing to integrate AI capabilities into our products and services.' The stock trades at 24.6x FY24E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Google Search specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS -35.4%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.4%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.7%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +65.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2024-02-01) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.95x (64.6% downside to Bear $50.58 / +67.9% upside to Bull $239.66) | Adj composite 2.07 vs market 2.03: gap +0.04 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $116.00 (20x FY24E $5.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +28.3% total (+14.1%/yr) | At 24.6x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $188.73 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +13.5% YoY in Q4 2023, forward revenues +13.5% (Q4 2023 revenue growth (no Q1 2024 guide)); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
